confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and are bounded to typical Taichung ranges for July 2026. The FX figure comes from RBA-attributed search-result excerpts (the 16 October 2026 table value and the 15 October 4.00 pm homepage value) and was not verified by opening the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Taiwanese cities such as Tainan and Kaohsiung, with Taipei prices as a ceiling for hotels and cafes. Drink prices were set from the local beer price relationship where direct knowledge was weaker.
